hero.headline:
Solid wood.
Built to outlast the house it sits in.
hero.body: Alder & Ash is a two-person workshop for custom furniture and old-piece restoration. We mill, join and finish everything by hand, and we tell you the truth about what your grandmother's dresser is actually worth saving.

services.title: Custom Furniture
services.body: Tables, cabinets and built-ins made to the inch for your space, not the showroom floor. We draw it, mill it, and deliver it ready to live with.

services.title: Restoration & Repair
services.body: Wobbly chairs, sun-bleached tabletops, drawers that stopped sliding a decade ago. We rebuild the joints and refinish the surface so the piece holds for another fifty years.

services.title: Wood & Material Sourcing
services.body: Reclaimed barnwood, air-dried walnut, hardwoods bought direct from small mills. We source what a project actually needs instead of whatever's on the shelf.

process.title: Walk the piece or space
process.body: We come to you, take measurements or look over the piece, and talk through what it needs to hold up.

process.title: Build in the shop
process.body: Milling, joinery and finishing happen on our bench, with photos along the way so you're not guessing.

process.title: Deliver and set up
process.body: We deliver, place it, and walk you through care — oil, wax, or whatever the wood actually needs.

contact.heading: Start a commission
contact.body: Every piece starts with a conversation about the wood, the space, and the budget. Send us a few details and we'll follow up within a couple of days.

footer.text: Alder & Ash — Hudson Valley, New York
